files.purpose: Transitive #print axioms for all five exported declarations, including both pure-tensor formulas.

checks.axiom_results: All five exported producers depend only on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx or added axioms.

consumer.intended: Determinant/exterior-line scalar extension and Plucker scalar extension in the Hermitian number-field route to Bost tensor semistability.
consumer.implemented_by_port: For every commutative R-algebra S, S tensor_R exteriorPower_R^i M is S-linearly equivalent to exteriorPower_S^i (S tensor_R M), with forward unit pure-tensor and inverse arbitrary pure-tensor formulas.
consumer.status: Producer infrastructure only; no determinant/Plucker consumer is claimed to be implemented by this port.

remaining_boundaries: Naturality with respect to module maps and algebra extension towers is not supplied as a named theorem by this port.
Identification with the project's determinant line and Plucker constructions remains a downstream bridge.
Compatibility with Hermitian metrics, isometries, covolumes, and Arakelov degree remains open.
This port does not prove rectangular Specht scalar extension, determinant-character identification, SL-invariant fibers, or the Bost conjecture.
